newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (P to Z) - Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (P to Z) - Oct 7.

text.p: TERMS: A$2.40 cash per share, to take the form of a
cash payment of A$2.30 together with a 10 cent fully franked special dividend to be declared by the offeree.
NOTES: Directors recommend shareholders accept the
offer in the absence of a higher bid. Offeror is entitled to 99.16 percent of the target's capital and will proceed with compulsory acquisition.
TERMS: Four shares in the offeror for each share held
and three shares in the offeror for every two options held.
NOTES: Offeror proposes to acquire all the issued
capital of the offeree. The offer will be conditional upon 90 percent acceptance and the necessary regulatory approvals in Canada and Australia and the approval of Mineral Resources shareholders.
TERMS: Four Capital shares for every one Stirling share
and is conditional on minimum acceptances of 30 percent of Stirling shares.
NOTES: Capital is now entitled to 39.9 percent of
Stirling's issued capital. Independent Stirling directors have advised shareholders to reject the offer
TERMS: Nine shares in IAMA for every 10 shares held in
NOTES: IAMA holds about 16.81 percent of Primac's
issued capital. Directors recommend shareholders take no action although they note the bid appeared totally inadequate.
TERMS: Three GUD shares for every eight Sunbeam shares
conditional on 90 percent acceptance. On July 9, offer increased to one share in the offeror and 54 cents cash for every three Sunbeam shares.
NOTES: GUD is now entitled to 96.7 percent of
Sunbeam's capital and will proceed with compulsory acquisition.
TERMS: A$2.30 cash per share ex-dividend and 15 cents
NOTES: Directors recommend shareholders not sell their
shares pending further advice. Offeror is now entitled to 77.1 percent of the issued capital of the offeree.
TERMS: A$5.30 per share, raised from $4.85 cash per
NOTES: Offer conditional on 90 percent acceptance and
the All Ordinaries index not falling below 2000 points. Directors advise shareholders to reject the advised offer. Offeror is entitled to 17.95 percent of offeree.
